name: ASF Group Limited
summary: ASF Group Limited, an investment and trading house, operates in the oil and gas, resources, property, infrastructure, travel, and financial services sectors in Australia, China, the United Kingdom, and the rest of Europe. It holds interests in copper-gold and gold mineralization projects in Queensland; a potash project in Western Australia; oil and gas projects in the Canning Basin, Western Australia; conventional and unconventional oil and gas projects in the North Perth and Canning Basin, Western Australia; and coal tenements in Queensland. The company also develops tourism, mixed-use, and urban regeneration projects. In addition, it offers property marketing services, as well as fund management and advisory services on public listing, visa migration, and funds management. ASF Group Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Sydney, Australia.
